# commodity — harness

**Commodity Desks** · domain `commodities` · lifecycle `active` · tier `standard` · owner team `data-platform` · 3 sisters

What every sister project inherits, decided once for the family. A sister may opt out of a tool, lower a loop's level or commit to more controls; it may not read another sister, and only the roll-up attaches sister warehouses, read-only.

## Inherited by every sister

| decision | file | effect |
|---|---|---|
| tools | `tools.yaml` | `okf`, `openmetadata`, `recce`, `wren` — each sister may set `enabled: false` |
| loops | `loops.yaml` | `freshness-triage` (cadence), `metric-gap-harvester` (4 waivers); off: `vendor-drift` |
| AI controls | `air.yaml` | baseline 0, accepted 0; a sister's baseline is a union with this one |
| delivery | `notify.yaml` | `ask` → `${PF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_COMMODITY_ASK}`, `default` → `${PF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_COMMODITY}`, `loops` → `${PF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_COMMODITY_LOOPS}` |
| budget and data | `group.yaml` | 40,000 tokens a day; residency `local`, retention 3650 d, erasure SLA 30 d |
| ontology | `ontology/instance.yaml` + `extension.yaml` | classes `Product`, `Currency`, `Location`; validated by `pf check` |
| shared dbt | `shared/transform/` | 2 macros, 4 seeds, 2 tests; identical in every sister |
| shared python | `shared/python/` | `commodity_shared` |
| skills | `.claude/skills/` | `add-a-commodity`, `add-a-market`, `price-arithmetic`, `price-feed-triage` — the `commodity-group` plugin, enabled in every sister's settings |
| memory | `.memory/notes/` | 1 note; `pf memory add groups/commodity …` |
| evals | `evals/` | 1 case the whole family must pass |

The skills:

- `add-a-commodity` — Add a tracked commodity in two halves, the group half (catalog row or indicative level, unit, classes, annotation roles) and the sister half (market unit, duty, contract lot), then seed every sister and read the cards.
- `add-a-market` — Add a country to the commodity family as its own sister project — one row in the market registry, one scaffold, the market's own seeds, the conformed models copied unchanged — then seed it and register it with the roll-up.
- `price-arithmetic` — Convert a commodity price in the conformed order, minor currency then unit then FX then duty, each step once, in intermediate or a mart, never in staging or dlt.
- `price-feed-triage` — Classify a stale or empty price load before touching anything, calendar, feed, symbol, cursor or contract, from the load's row counts, the dlt trace and the two loops that surface it.

## The gate, from the group directory

Judged the way the PreToolUse hook judges a session opened here — which is *not* inside a project, and that matters for the last rows.

| path | verdict | by |
|---|---|---|
| `tools.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `loops.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `air.yaml` | impact first | impact_required `**/air.yaml` |
| `notify.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `group.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `ontology/instance.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `ontology/extension.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `shared/transform/macros/example.sql` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.sql` |
| `shared/transform/seeds/example.csv` | allowed | default |
| `.claude/skills/example/SKILL.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `kg/group_card.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `HARNESS.md` | allowed | denylist_except |
| `loop-ledger.json` | allowed | default |
| `evals/example.json` | allowed | default |
| `.memory/notes/example.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `projects/example/CLAUDE.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `platform/src/pf/cli.py` | allowed | default |
| `vendor/example/README.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `gate.yaml` | allowed | default |

`platform_denylist` — `platform/**`, `vendor/**`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `gate.yaml`, `gate.capabilities.yaml` — applies only when the session resolves to a project.

**These maps travel with the change** (`harness_required`): a run that changes a group-level file must leave every map in the family current, and a run that changes a sister must leave the sister's, its report's and this one current. `pf harness commodity` regenerates them all.

## Gaps

- **A group session may write shared infrastructure.** `platform_denylist` applies only when the hook resolves the session to a project; a session opened at `groups/commodity` resolves to none, so `platform/src/pf/cli.py`, `vendor/example/README.md` are allowed. Open project work with `pf work`, and platform work at the root.
- **No AI-control baseline.** `air.yaml` commits to nothing, so `pf air gate` passes by finding nothing to check. `pf air baseline commodity <project> --suggest` proposes one.

---

Regenerate with `pf harness commodity`; every `pf bootstrap` of a sister does too. `pf harness check` fails on the drift.
